lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Eu2Ru2O12 (reduced formula K2EuRuO6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Eu and Ru each in octahedral oxygen coordination (6 neighbors each, 2 unit-cell atoms per environment), while K adopts a close-packed-like 12-oxygen local arrangement. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between EuO6 and RuO6 octahedra, plus face-sharing between K-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and both EuO6 and RuO6 octahedra.
